Reserved Path Prefix
RFC 8615 reserves the path prefix `/.well-known/`.

* **Supporting quote:**  
  > "To address these uses, this memo reserves a path prefix in HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket (WS), and Secure WebSocket (WSS) URIs for these \"well-known locations\", \"/.well-known/\"." (Section 1)

---

### 2. Registration Policy for New Well-Known URIs
The registration policy is **Specification Required**, evaluated with designated expert review.

* **Supporting quote:**  
  > "Well-known URIs are registered on the advice of one or more experts, with a Specification Required (using terminology from [RFC8126])." (Section 5.1)

---

### 3. Applicable URI Schemes
RFC 8615 directly updates and applies to `http` and `https`, and applies to any other URI scheme whose definition explicitly permits well-known URIs (such as `ws`, `wss`, `coap`, `coap+tcp`, `coap+ws`, `coaps`, `coaps+tcp`, and `coaps+ws`).

* **Supporting quotes:**  
  > "A well-known URI is a URI [RFC3986] whose path component begins with the characters \"/.well-known/\", provided that the scheme is explicitly defined to support well-known URIs." (Section 3)

  > "This specification updates the \"http\" [RFC7230] and \"https\" [RFC7230] schemes to support well-known URIs." (Section 3)

  > "Well-known URIs can also be used with other URI schemes, but only when those schemes' definitions explicitly allow it." (Section 1)

---
